editorial.blurb: Fora is a modern American spot in West Loop with excellent food, beautiful outdoor spaces with fire pits, and a sophisticated yet cozy vibe—when the service hits its stride.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for lunch or happy hour when the staff is more attentive; try the Power Lunch special ($25 for 3 courses) or order the shaved brussel sprouts salad, which reviewers rave about.
